scenario.name: r-cw-6-max-chain-length
scenario.description: The live chain-depth boundary requires an isolated fixture that lowers maxChainLength, restarts safely, proves the hop boundary, then restores and restarts.
scenario.registryNotes: The scaffold intentionally cannot run until an explicitly authorized fixture implements backup/lower/restart/fire/restore/restart receipts.

expectedReceipts.name: seat-readiness-continuation-enabled
expectedReceipts.description: Precursor receipt proves continuation defaults before fixture mutation.

expectedReceipts.name: original-config-captured
expectedReceipts.description: The original maxChainLength value is retained for restoration.

expectedReceipts.name: failure-safe-restore-armed
expectedReceipts.description: A restore-and-restart guard is armed before mutation.

expectedReceipts.name: config-set-to-1
expectedReceipts.description: The fixture records maxChainLength=1 and the first restart.

expectedReceipts.name: hop-1-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: The first hop is accepted at the configured boundary.

expectedReceipts.name: hop-2-rejected
expectedReceipts.description: The next hop is rejected at the chain boundary.

expectedReceipts.name: config-restored
expectedReceipts.description: The original limit is restored and the gateway restart receipt is captured.

review.notes: This is the live chain-boundary claim. It is not proven by static checks.

liveRunSafety.notes: Fail closed until a separately authorized disposable fixture captures the full mutation, restart, and restoration chain.
